Claim 13 (Currently Amended): A flexible respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the tube arrangement comprising: a flexible tube; a heater to heat the gas as it is delivered through the tube; a first connector provided to one end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a breathing mask; and a second connector provided to the other end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a CPAP device, said second connector including a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage and a second portion that provides integrated contact elements by which power is supplied to said heater, wherein said contact elements are adapted to be engaged with a power supply provided on the CPAP device for supplying power to said heater, __and wherein said contact elements are positioned to provide both an electric connection for power delivery and a pneumatic connection for gas passage when the connector is connected to the CPAP device__.

Claim 14 (Previously presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising an insulating sheathing body.

Claim 15 (Currently Amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the insulating sheathing body is removably attachable to the flexible tube __and is structured to provide thermal insulation of the flexible tube__.

Claim 16 (Cancelled)

Claim 17 (Previously presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein said sheathing body includes a multi-layered design.

Claim 18 (Previously presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the tube is a heatable respiratory gas tube.

Claim 19 (Previously presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the heater is integrated into the tube.

Claim 20 (Cancelled)

Claim 21 (Cancelled)

Claim 22 (Cancelled)

Claim 23 (Cancelled)

Claim 24 (Previously presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the flexible tube is made from a spirally reinforced plastic material.

Claim 25 (Previously presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the heater is an electrical resistance heater.

Claim 26 (Cancelled)

Claim 27 (Currently Amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage such that both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device.

Claim 28 (Previously presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the first portion is tubular and the second portion extends outwardly from the first portion.

Claim 29 (Cancelled)

Claim 30 (Currently Amended): A connector for connecting a CPAP device to a respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the respiratory gas tube arrangement including a heater, the connector comprising: a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage; and a second portion that provides integrated contact elements by which power is supplied to the heater, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage such that both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device.

Claim 31 (Previously presented): A connector according to claim 30, wherein the first portion is tubular and the second portion extends outwardly from the first portion.
